description: Java class representing a command to retrieve a specific attribute of a 'Thing' by its ID and JSON pointer within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for constructing the command, parsing from JSON, and retrieving command details.

classes.name: RetrieveAttribute
classes.description: Immutable class representing a command to retrieve a single attribute from a 'Thing' identified by ID and JSON pointer. Implements methods for creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and equality checks.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a RetrieveAttribute command with typed ThingId, JSON pointer, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a RetrieveAttribute command from JSON string or object, parsing necessary fields.

methods.name: getAttributePointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer specifying the attribute to retrieve.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing entity related to this command.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path representing the resource location for this command.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Builds the JSON payload for the command, including thing ID and attribute pointer.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new instance of RetrieveAttribute with specified headers.
